title: Lanterns of Saltmere
logline: The lighthouse lanterns of Saltmere went dark the night the tide stopped turning.
source_prompt: a cosy island adventure where you relight old lanterns with a fox companion

key_locations.name: Saltmere Harbor
key_locations.description: A ring of stone piers where the fishing boats wait for a tide that no longer comes.

key_locations.name: Gull Shrine
key_locations.description: A salt-crusted shrine where the keepers once trimmed the first flame.

key_locations.name: Drowned Arches
key_locations.description: Half-sunk arches of the old sea wall, green with weed.

key_locations.name: Beacon Summit
key_locations.description: The high point of the island and the great lantern that answered every ship.

characters.name: Keeper Maren
characters.description: The last lantern keeper, patient and weathered.

characters.name: Pip
characters.description: A small sea fox with a lantern-bright tail.

characters.name: Oska
characters.description: A travelling trader stranded by the still tide.

characters.name: Warden Bram
characters.description: Keeps watch over the shrine path.

characters.name: Tide Sentinel
characters.description: A hovering stone spirit that guards the drowned arches.

characters.name: Reef Crab
characters.description: A crab the size of a cart, territorial.

hazards: cold fog that hides the cliff edges
